observations: date_at: round-1 correction ({date}، {time} -> {date} کو {time}) judged on merit and ACCEPTED. The CLDR ur long date already carries ، inside it ("5 نومبر، 2026"), so the punctuation joiner doubled it; کو is the ordinary temporal postposition for a date and the composed label carries exactly one ،.

weekday_at is identical to English only as a pattern: ICU supplies the Urdu weekday (جمعرات) and no English word survives; the scoped IDENTICAL_OK row is accurate and enforced (proved by negative control).
Bare day-word + clock with no postposition is the catalogue's own precedent (ui.schedules.scheduled_task_dialog.tomorrow_at_9_00_am «کل صبح 9:00 بجے»), so weekday_at/today_at need no کو.

No English remains in the composed labels except the ICU day period (PM), a named exception: ur CLDR's abbreviated day periods are Latin. In an RTL paragraph it renders as an LTR island to the left of the digits (same arrangement as CLDR ar's «٣:٤٥ م»), i.e. the correct reading order.

Cross-surface note, not this key's defect: schedule copy writes «9:00 بجے» while the divider clock is the formatter's «3:45 PM». The catalogue cannot choose the day period; that would be an hour-cycle decision in the formatter layer.
limitations: Mirror-contained mechanical run (src/i18n, scripts/i18n, i18n, package.json via git archive, node_modules symlinked); no whole-suite run, no browser render — widths and bidi were measured on the composed strings, not on a painted frame.
Did not re-audit the other seven locales or any other namespace.
